parts.label: Cornea
parts.note: Clear front window that starts to bend the light

parts.label: Iris
parts.note: Coloured muscle ring that sets the pupil size

parts.label: Pupil
parts.note: The hole in the iris that lets light in

parts.label: Lens
parts.note: Changes shape to focus light on the retina

parts.label: Optic nerve
parts.note: Carries signals from the retina to the brain

parts.label: Vitreous humour
parts.note: Clear jelly that keeps the eyeball round
